laws.rule: On the Amalfi Coast road (SS163 Amalfitana), alternate number-plate rules apply from 10 am to 6 pm on set 2026 dates (Holy Week, late April to early May, weekends and holidays from June, every day in August and September, weekends in October): on even dates cars with plates ending in an even number may not drive, on odd dates odd plates may not. Residents of the coast's municipalities, taxis, hire cars with driver and emergency vehicles are among those exempt. Hire cars are not listed as exempt.
